name: Powkiddy RGB30
identify: helperFunctions.sh: /proc/cpuinfo part 0xd05 (RK3566) + /etc/os-release OS_NAME=DARKMOSS, SPRUCE_PLATFORM=RGB30 (or, pre-stamp images, the HW_DEVICE fallback)

vol.note: event1 adc-keys reports only a phantom 114 and is rejected by the resolver

L3.note: doubles as MENU in the default Button Settings > Menu button = L3 setting

R3.note: plain stick click by default; becomes MENU instead of L3 if Button Settings > Menu button is set to R3

VOL_UP.note: dArkMossCommon.cfg default; RGB30.cfg swaps B_VOLUP/B_VOLDOWN when Button Settings > Volume buttons is Swapped (some units have the rocker fitted the other way round). The lab RGB30's rocker is standard: RGB30-4 (2026-11-12) read + as 115 and - as 114 on Standard; runs 1-3's reversed readings were the buttons pressed the other way round (tester)

VOL_DOWN.note: dArkMossCommon.cfg default; RGB30.cfg swaps B_VOLUP/B_VOLDOWN when Button Settings > Volume buttons is Swapped (some units have the rocker fitted the other way round). The lab RGB30's rocker is standard: RGB30-4 (2026-11-12) read + as 115 and - as 114 on Standard; runs 1-3's reversed readings were the buttons pressed the other way round (tester)

RIGHT_STICK.cfg_differs: the cfg names STICK_RIGHT_2 "3 2" (ABS_Z, which this pad lacks) and STICK_DOWN_2 "3 3" (ABS_RX, which is across); on hardware right gives ABS_RX (3) and down ABS_RY (4)
RIGHT_STICK.over_cfg: measured (2026-11-12); spruce keeps its cfg lines, so Button Reader expects and draws these axes instead

absent.MENU: no Menu button on the RGB30 (tester 2026-11-12; no input on the step in RGB30-1/2); RGB30.cfg's B_MENU reuses L3's code (317) per Button Settings > Menu button

notes: No dedicated MENU button: by default a tap of L3 (1 317) is both L3 and MENU (Button Settings > Menu button, default L3); the alternative setting swaps this so R3 (1 318) is MENU instead and L3 stays a plain stick click. The code/source below is the default (L3) branch; the other stick click (R3 by default) is a plain click with no MENU role.
Volume rocker may be hardware-swapped on some units; Button Settings > Volume buttons "Swapped" flips B_VOLUP/DOWN to 1 114/1 115 instead of the dArkMossCommon default 1 115/1 114 used below.
No rumble motor from the factory (the PWM and FF_RUMBLE are present for a solder mod); unrelated to Button Reader but may confuse a tester expecting feedback.
